events.text: A gambling den owner wants a quiet, frightening person to stand by the door. Pay is good; the customers are not.

choices.text: Take the job for a season

effects.log: Nobody cheats while you are watching. (40 taels)
He shrugs. There are always other frightening people.

events.text: A crew of pickpockets needs someone to cause a distraction in the market while they work.

effects.log: The best-attended juggling show in the county. The crew gives you a cut. (15 taels)
The crew scatters and learns your face.

events.text: A forger offers you a travel pass with a magistrate's seal on it, perfect in every way except that it is not real.

effects.log: It works at every checkpoint. You feel slightly sick each time. (−20 taels)
The forger is arrested. His customers are not pleased with you.

events.text: A constable recognises you from a night that was supposed to be forgotten. His hand is already on your shoulder.

ok.log: Rooftop, alley, canal. He loses you in the fish market.

fail.log: He is faster than he looks. The magistrate sends you to prison.

effects.log: The magistrate notes your manners and gives you one year instead of two.

events.text: A fence in the back of a pawnshop buys anything, asks nothing, and remembers everything.

effects.log: He pays badly and remembers your face. (10 taels)

choices.text: Ask what he remembers about others

effects.log: For five taels he tells you who has been buying poisons lately.

events.text: A crew is planning to rob a corrupt salt official's vault. They need someone who can climb.

ok.log: Over the wall, through the window, down with the silver. The official cannot report what he stole first. (120 taels)

fail.log: The dogs wake. You are caught on the wall.

effects.log: They go without you. Two of them hang. You never regret refusing.

events.text: You could rob the rich salt merchants and leave the silver on poor doorsteps. The idea will not leave you alone.

ok.log: Forty doorsteps, forty surprised families at dawn. The merchant does not even notice.

fail.log: You are caught at the first house.

events.text: You overhear a magistrate taking a bribe. He sees you see it.

effects.log: He pays, and hates you forever. (50 taels)
You forget it. He does not forget you.

events.text: A counterfeiter offers you a bag of fake silver at one-tenth its face value.

effects.log: He laughs and offers the bag to the next person.
The constables pay you back and thank you. (+5 taels)

events.text: The Black Wind's recruiter watches you work a night job. 'You are good. Come with us and the jobs get bigger.'

effects.log: He names a number. It is a very large number. You say you will think.
